title: Brilliantly Optimized
description: An optimization modpack with no useless features.
body:
This is an optimization modpack with no filler. Some mods may be incompatible with older devices like Super Resolution. Also make sure to use the config since it removes all of the mod conflicts, further improving FPS.

(ALSO THE GALLERY ONLY FEATURES V1.0, NOT FUTURE VERSIONS. YOU'LL GET BETTER FPS WITH NEWER ONES.)

If you want a lightweight version or a version for low end devices/android devices, there is a lowend version of Brilliantly Optimized specifically made for ARM-based devices or weak CPUs.

DISABLE VOXY IF YOU DON'T WANT THE RENDER DISTANCE, YOU'LL LOSE A LOT OF FPS IF YOU DON'T.

If you want purely FPS, get the Vulkan version as I get 2-3x~ FPS. But no shader support.

If you want your mod gone, message me on discord (@quippykc).
